added: Experimental: print calling cards on ordinary paper. Turn on Several cards to a page in Settings › Experimental › Calling cards, and the cards are laid out as many to a page as fit on the paper you choose when printing, with marks to cut along — four 3 × 5 cards to a Letter page, four A6 or eight A7 to an A4 page.

changed: The calling_card_print setting's classification note mentions that it also records whether cards print several to a page.
